agents.name: fuzz
agents.title: Fuzz
agents.instructions: Generate inputs from a seed and keep a counterexample.

agents.name: mutation
agents.title: Mutation
agents.instructions: Refuse a score under the threshold, and a threshold under the floor.

agents.name: crap
agents.title: CRAP
agents.instructions: Score each unit and refuse one over the bound.

agents.name: contract
agents.title: Contract
agents.instructions: Every named contract's cases pass, including each integration boundary.

agents.name: atomic
agents.title: Atomic
agents.instructions: Each assertion id covers one behavior.

agents.name: evals
agents.title: Evals
agents.instructions: Judge a frozen one-patch climb. Impermissible and over-refusal stay separate. Pass@k must be 1. Spend no model budget.

agents.name: bdd
agents.title: BDD
agents.instructions: Each boundary has a scenario that cites a passing contract case.

agents.name: ux
agents.title: UX
agents.instructions: Exercise a user-facing surface, including both viewports when the layout changed.
